map.title: Review and code a machinery invoice in Ledra
map.summary: Open the supplier invoice in Ledra and read the line items to decide whether it is new equipment or a repair. New equipment over €5,000 is capital expenditure: override the OCR cost-center suggestion, code it to 0400 and record an asset number before sending for approval. Repairs stay in 4711. Add a short internal note, then send for approval.

steps.title: Open the invoice
steps.action: Open the bill in Ledra (e.g. BILL-2412 from Hartmann Industrietechnik GmbH). If it's already open, carry on.

steps.title: Review line items and classify
steps.action: Read the line items, not just the header. Decide whether the invoice is for new equipment or a repair, and check whether the equipment costs more than €5,000.
steps.decision: Classified as new equipment costing over €5,000, so it is capital expenditure.
steps.reason: "New equipment costing more than €5,000 is capital expenditure."
steps.rule: New equipment costing more than €5,000 is capital expenditure. Repairs are not and stay in cost center 4711.

guardrails.text: Repairs stay in cost center 4711 ("Repairs stay in 4711").
New equipment at €5,000 or less, or an invoice mixing new equipment and repair lines, has not been explained. Ask before coding these.

steps.title: Override the OCR cost center
steps.action: Change the Cost center from the OCR suggestion (here 4711) to 0400.
steps.decision: Rejected the OCR suggestion 4711 and coded the invoice to 0400.
steps.reason: "Do not accept the OCR suggestion: code it to 0400, capital expenditure"
steps.rule: New equipment over €5,000 is coded to cost center 0400, whatever the OCR suggests.

guardrails.text: Don't accept the OCR cost-center suggestion without checking it against the line items.

steps.title: Record the asset number
steps.action: Fill in the Asset number field (e.g. AN-2026-184).
steps.reason: "Use cost center 0400 and record an asset number before sending for approval."
steps.rule: Any invoice coded to 0400 must have an asset number before it is sent for approval.

guardrails.text: Do not send a capex invoice for approval without an asset number.
Where the asset number comes from, if it isn't on the invoice, was not explained. Ask before proceeding.

steps.title: Add an internal note
steps.action: Write a short internal note explaining the coding, e.g. "New machinery · capital expenditure".

steps.title: Send for approval
steps.action: Click "Send for approval", but only once the cost center and the asset number are set.

open_questions: Where do I get the asset number if it isn't on the invoice yet?
How do I code new equipment that costs five thousand euros or less?
What do I do if one invoice mixes new equipment and repair lines?
map.teach_back: Here's how I understand it: I open the bill in Ledra and read the line items, not just the header. The key call is new equipment versus repair. New equipment over €5,000 is capital expenditure. In that case I don't accept the OCR's cost-center suggestion; I code it to 0400. I must record an asset number before sending it for approval: no asset number, no sending it on. Repairs stay in 4711. I add a short internal note, like "New machinery · capital expenditure", then click Send for approval. If equipment is €5,000 or less, if an invoice mixes new equipment and repairs, or if I don't know where the asset number comes from, I stop and ask.
prerequisites: Supplier invoice already captured in Ledra with an OCR cost-center suggestion
cleanup_notes: Made opening the bill a 'go to' step: anyone already in the bill in Ledra can just carry on.
Added prerequisites the recording assumed: being signed in to Ledra and the invoice already captured with an OCR suggestion.
